label: Lantronix SpiderDuo SLS200 single-port KVM-over-IP
description: Server-powered zero-U KVM-over-IP dongle for one server: USB keyboard/mouse and video (up to 1280x1024 at 60 Hz) are tunnelled over a single 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 to a Java-free browser client for up to eight simultaneous users, with virtual media and an RS-232 serial port for console redirection or an external modem.
notes: User guide 900-495J, SpiderDuo technical data: 'Network: One 10/100/1000 Base-T Ethernet Port with activity indicators (RJ45)', and 'Ethernet Ports--Connects to the LAN. The SpiderDuo device has one port only that connects to the LAN.' The two-port Network + Cascade arrangement and the internal 'hardware Ethernet switch' described in the same guide belong to the Spider SLS100, not the SpiderDuo, so this model correctly carries a single Ethernet port and no l2-forward. The RJ45 serial port is RS-232 (up to 115200 baud). Server-powered from the USB/PS2 cable, with an optional external PSU.
